info.name: Project-Team-404 API - 340-current-upcoming-tasks
info.description: Current and upcoming tasks dashboard API checks. Uses seeded James and Harvey accounts; setup creates disposable test rows.

item.name: 340-current-upcoming-tasks
item.description: Run in order. Setup requests create date-relative fixtures, then each request validates one behavior.

exec: const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).formatToParts(new Date());
const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day + days));

item.name: Login - James (token, Asia/Manila)

exec: pm.test('Login returns a token and Manila profile', function () { pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.user.timezone).to.equal('Asia/Manila'); });

item.name: Case - Due today is returned by default

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); const tasks = Array.isArray(body) ? body : (Array.isArray(body.tasks) ? body.tasks : []);
pm.test('Response body has the documented task result shape', function () { pm.expect(Array.isArray(body) || Array.isArray(body.tasks)).to.equal(true); });
pm.test('Task due today in Manila is returned', function () { pm.expect(tasks.map((task) => String(task.id))).to.include(pm.environment.get('todayTaskId')); });

item.name: Case - Same instant uses Manila local date

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); const tasks = Array.isArray(body) ? body : (Array.isArray(body.tasks) ? body.tasks : []); const ids = tasks.map((task) => String(task.id));
pm.test('Response body has the documented task result shape', function () { pm.expect(Array.isArray(body) || Array.isArray(body.tasks)).to.equal(true); });

pm.test('Manila date boundary is applied to the same run instant', function () { const manilaDay = pm.environment.get('todayManila'); const westDay = pm.environment.get('todayWest'); const expected = manilaDay === westDay; pm.expect(ids.includes(pm.environment.get('manilaWestDateTaskId'))).to.equal(expected); });

item.name: Setup - Ensure clean empty-result account

exec: pm.test('Empty-result account is created or already exists', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 409]); });

if (pm.response.code === 201) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('New account includes its Inbox', function () { pm.expect(body.userId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.inboxProjectId).to.be.a('number'); }); } else { pm.test('Existing account conflict includes an error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; }); }

item.name: Setup - Login empty-result account
Case - User with no matching tasks gets empty result

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); const tasks = Array.isArray(body) ? body : (Array.isArray(body.tasks) ? body.tasks : null);
pm.test('Response body has the documented empty task shape', function () { pm.expect(Array.isArray(body) || Array.isArray(body.tasks)).to.equal(true); pm.expect(tasks).to.deep.equal([]); });
